title: I created a Turducken with three heads that argue with each other.
author: TheFrandroid
selftext:
I work on the roguelite [YOU vs ZOMBIES](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224660/YOU_vs_Zombies/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=thanksgiving_turducken&utm_content=r_roguelites), where you describe a character and the game uses AI to turn our art into your hero. For Thanksgiving I gave it the task of a Turducken. All three heads talk, they argue with each other and they really don't want to be eaten, especially by zombies!

The GIF goes from the prompt to the actual run. For anyone else building prompt-driven mechanics, how much detail do you want people to specify? I was very particular about the heads and I wanted each head to argue with each others skills at fighting.
